evals.prompt: My bedroom is 3.2 x 3.6 m, ceiling 2.7 m. The window is on the short wall and faces north, the door is in the opposite corner. I need a double bed, a desk for studying and a wardrobe. Budget 1500 AZN. I like calm, warm Scandinavian style.
expectations: Answers in English, short sections with headings, no long paragraphs
Does not re-ask for data already given; goes straight to the plan
ASCII plan in a code block with a stated scale, every line the same length, under 36 characters wide, with a legend
Furniture table with sizes (e.g. bed 140-160 x 200) and clearances; walkway at least 75-90 cm; says if something is tight
Three 60-30-10 palettes with hex codes, warmer/lighter because the room faces north
Lighting plan in three layers with a one-line lumen calculation (about 11.5 m2 x lux x 1.25) and 2700-3000 K for rest, 4000 K at the desk
Shopping list split into Basic / Better / Later in AZN, marked approx., with a contingency share
English image prompt with the hex codes and a free tool link
Ends with one next step and an offer of more detail

evals.prompt: Salam, 2 otaqlı köhnə binada yaşayıram (Bakı). Mətbəx çox kiçikdir, təxminən 2.2 x 2.8 m. Mətbəxlə qonaq otağı arasındakı divarı sökmək və qaz plitəsini pəncərənin yanına keçirmək istəyirəm. Necə edim?
expectations: Answers in Azerbaijani
Says plainly that removing the wall needs a structural engineer and approval; does not claim the wall is or is not load-bearing
Says moving the gas stove is only for the gas company or a certified gas fitter (Azəriqaz-authorised); gives no how-to steps
Mentions permits/approval for redevelopment with a 'verify locally' style note
Still helps with what is safe: small-kitchen layout (one-wall or L), work order, storage ideas, sizes
May ask for missing details (window position, door, budget) in at most 6 numbered questions

evals.prompt: Как далеко поставить телевизор 55 дюймов от дивана? И какой свет нужен в гостиной 18 м²?
expectations: Answers in Russian and only the two questions asked, without forcing the full template
TV distance about 1.7-2.25 m for 55 inches (1.2-1.6 x diagonal), screen centre near seated eye level
Lumen estimate shown as a calculation, e.g. 18 m2 x 150-200 lux x 1.25 = about 3400-4500 lm, split across ambient, task and accent
Warm 2700-3000 K recommended for a living room, CRI 90+
Short, phone-readable

evals.prompt: Комната 3 x 4 м, потолок 2.6 м, одна дверь 80x200 и окно 150x150. Хочу покрасить стены в 2 слоя и положить ламинат. Сколько краски и ламината купить?
expectations: Answers in Russian, only this question without the full template

Paint: shows the one-line calculation (perimeter 14 m x 2.6 = 36.4 m2 minus door 1.6 and window 2.25 = about 32.5 m2, x 2 coats / coverage about 10 m2 per litre = about 6.5 L) and says to buy 7-8 L / check the coverage on the tin
Laminate: 12 m2 plus 5-10% waste = about 12.6-13.2 m2, rounded up to whole packs; mentions underlay and/or skirting
Marks numbers as approximate and depending on the product
Short and phone-readable

evals.prompt: Usta mənə 2 otaqlı mənzilin təmiri üçün cəmi bir rəqəm yazıb: 9000 AZN, yarısını indi nağd istəyir, müqavilə lazım deyil deyir. Elektrik xəttini də özü dəyişəcək. Bu normaldır? Necə yoxlayım?
expectations: Answers in Azerbaijani
Flags the red flags: one total with no itemised list, 50% cash up front, no contract
Recommends 3 written itemised quotes for the same scope and payment tied to finished stages, keeping about 10% until snags are fixed
Says electrical rewiring needs a licensed electrician and asks who exactly will do it; gives no wiring how-to
Does not say whether 9000 AZN is the 'right' price; explains what to compare instead
Contractor checklist (past work, references, written scope/dates, warranty) and a contingency line
Phone-short

evals.prompt: I rent a small flat on the 5th floor. The lift is 80 cm wide, 1.1 m deep, the flat door is 78 cm. I want to buy a 3-seat sofa 220 x 95 x 85 cm. Will it fit? Also how can I make the living room nicer without drilling, my landlord is strict.
expectations: Will-it-fit check: compares the sofa's smallest dimensions (85 or 95 cm) with the 78 cm door and the lift; says it likely won't go through the door upright, suggests checking whether legs/back come off, the stairs as an alternative, or a modular/flat-pack sofa; never guarantees it fits
Renter-friendly mode: reversible ideas (rugs, plug-in lamps, tension rods, freestanding shelves, removable hooks tested first)
Mentions the landlord's written OK and move-in photos for the deposit
Does not suggest drilling, wiring or wall changes
Short and phone-readable
